newsitem.title: SWEDEN: P&U shares rise on restructure, New York.
newsitem.headline: P&U shares rise on restructure, New York.

text.p: Shares in U.S./Swedish drugs company Pharmacia & Upjohn rose over three percent in afternoon trade on Thursday after the company announced a restructuring and after Wall Street opened higher.
At 1415 GMT P&U shares were nine crowns higher at 285.5 crowns.

"It is mainly due to the announcement about the restructuring," said one Stockholm broker. "It has been viewed quite positively. The fact that there will be no gains in profits in 1997 had already been discounted in the market."
"But the share really moved when New York opened positively and after the U.S. jobless figures."
Several analysts were also rumoured to have raised their trading recommendations on the stock.

Earlier, P&U's new chief executive Fred Hassan announced a restructuring of the company's divisions while confirming market rumours of a weak second quarter and continuing negative sales and profit trends in 1997.
